task.goal: Determine whether the existing focused lifecycle test already proves the stale-source-freeze restart invariant and, only where assertions are missing, merge one permanent public lifecycle invariant into that existing test.
task.hypothesis: The existing focused restart test proves only incompatible-budget retirement, so one merged stale-source-freeze scenario is needed to prove atomic retirement, byte-for-byte old-freeze preservation, exact stranded-outcome restoration, idempotence, and distinct current-source successor run and freeze creation through ordinary pick/readiness.

pass_criteria: the one declared focused test executes at least once and passes
the public stale-source-freeze restart terminally retires the unusable old run and restores exactly its stranded outcome to ready in one application result
the old source-freeze row retains the same identity and byte-for-byte field value after retirement and repeated restart is idempotent
the next ordinary pick and readiness path create a distinct FeatureRun with one distinct source freeze bound to current source
no production behavior, second test file, full suite, adapter state, release, or publication changes

stop_conditions: a second permanent invariant is proposed
production behavior or product-plan contract edit
old dogfood adapter item or run mutation
